scripts.script:
local Fluent = loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://github.com/dawid-scripts/Fluent/releases/latest/download/main.lua"))()
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")

-- AYARLAR
local GithubUser = "oldhacfard" 
local CheckInterval = 30 -- Yeni script kontrolü için bekleme süresi (saniye)

local Window = Fluent:CreateWindow({
    Title = GithubUser .. " Cloud Hub",
    SubTitle = "Auto-Sync & Notify",
    TabWidth = 160,
    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(580, 520),
    Acrylic = true,
    Theme = "Dark",
    MinimizeKey = Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl
})

local Tabs = {}
local KnownFiles = {} -- Mevcut dosyaları takip etmek için tablo

-- Veri çekme fonksiyonu
local function GetData(url)
    local success, res = pcall(function()
        return game:HttpGet(url)
    end)
    if success and res then
        return HttpService:JSONDecode(res)
    end
    return nil
end

-- Dosyayı Buton Olarak Ekleme Fonksiyonu
local function AddFileButton(tab, repoName, branch, filePath)
    local rawUrl = string.format("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/%s/%s/%s/%s", GithubUser, repoName, branch, filePath)
    
    tab:AddButton({
        Title = filePath,
        Description = "Çalıştırmak için tıkla",
        Callback = function()
            local s, content = pcall(function() return game:HttpGet(rawUrl) end)
            if s then
                local exec, err = pcall(function() loadstring(content)() end)
                if exec then
                    Fluent:Notify({Title = "Başarılı", Content = filePath .. " açıldı.", Duration = 2})
                else
                    print("Hata veya Düz Metin:\n" .. content)
                end
            end
        end
    })
end

-- Tüm Arşivi ve Yeni Dosyaları Yükleme/Kontrol Etme
local function SyncGithub(isFirstLoad)
    local repos = GetData("https://api.github.com/users/" .. GithubUser .. "/repos?per_page=100")
    if not repos then return end

    for _, repo in pairs(repos) do
        local repoName = repo.name
        local branch = repo.default_branch or "main"
        
        -- Eğer bu repo için henüz sekme yoksa oluştur
        if not Tabs[repoName] then
            Tabs[repoName] = Window:AddTab({ Title = repoName, Icon = "folder" })
        end

        local tree = GetData(string.format("https://api.github.com/repos/%s/%s/git/trees/%s?recursive=1", GithubUser, repoName, branch))
        
        if tree and tree.tree then
            for _, file in pairs(tree.tree) do
                if file.type == "blob" then
                    local fileKey = repoName .. "/" .. file.path
                    
                    -- Eğer dosya sistemde kayıtlı değilse (YENİ DOSYA)
                    if not KnownFiles[fileKey] then
                        KnownFiles[fileKey] = true
                        
                        -- Butonu ekle
                        AddFileButton(Tabs[repoName], repoName, branch, file.path)

                        -- Eğer ilk açılış değilse bildirim gönder
                        if not isFirstLoad then
                            Fluent:Notify({
                                Title = "Yeni Script Tespit Edildi!",
                                Content = repoName .. " deposuna '" .. file.path .. "' eklendi.",
                                SubContent = "Menüye otomatik eklendi.",
                                Duration = 10
                            })
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

-- Arka Plan Kontrol Döngüsü
task.spawn(function()
    -- İlk yükleme (Bildirimsiz)
    SyncGithub(true)
    
    -- Sürekli Kontrol (Bildirimli)
    while task.wait(CheckInterval) do
        pcall(function()
            SyncGithub(false)
        end)
    end
end)

-- [[ FE CUBE MONSTER ULTIMATE V9 ]]
-- Специально для Глеба
-- Фикс: Голова по центру (0), смотрит ПРЯМО, только вверх-вниз

local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local mouse = player:GetMouse()
local char = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()

-- 1. НЕВИДИМОСТЬ
for _, part in pairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
    if part:IsA("BasePart") or part:IsA("Decal") then part.Transparency = 1 end
end

local function createCube(size, offset, name)
    local cube = Instance.new("Part", char)
    cube.Name = name; cube.Size = size; cube.Color = Color3.fromRGB(100, 100, 100)
    cube.Material = Enum.Material.Neon; cube.CanCollide = false
    local weld = Instance.new("Weld", cube)
    weld.Part0 = char.HumanoidRootPart; weld.Part1 = cube; weld.C0 = offset
    return cube
end

-- 2. ТЕЛО (Голова теперь ровно на 0 по X и смотрит ПРЯМО)
local head = createCube(Vector3.new(2.5, 2.5, 2.5), CFrame.new(0, 4, 0), "CubeHead")
local lHand = createCube(Vector3.new(1.5, 1.5, 1.5), CFrame.new(-3, 1, 0), "LeftHand")
local rHand = createCube(Vector3.new(1.5, 1.5, 1.5), CFrame.new(3, 1, 0), "RightHand")

-- 3. ОРУЖИЕ (Меч -180, Нож -90)
local function addWeapon(id, parentPart, offset)
    local obj = game:GetObjects("rbxassetid://"..id)[1]
    obj.Parent = char
    for _, v in pairs(obj:GetDescendants()) do
        if v:IsA("Script") or v:IsA("LocalScript") then v:Destroy() end
    end
    local handle = obj:FindFirstChild("Handle") or obj:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
    if handle then
        handle.CanCollide = false
        local w = Instance.new("Weld", handle)
        w.Part0 = parentPart; w.Part1 = handle; w.C0 = offset
    end
end

addWeapon(47433, rHand, CFrame.new(0, 0, -2) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-180), 0, 0))
addWeapon(3576051114, lHand, CFrame.new(0, 0, -1.5) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-90), 0, 0))

-- 4. ЗВУКИ
local sKnife = Instance.new("Sound", char.HumanoidRootPart)
sKnife.SoundId = "rbxassetid://136518851744814"
local sSword = Instance.new("Sound", char.HumanoidRootPart)
sSword.SoundId = "rbxassetid://111147793954530"

-- 5. АТАКА
mouse.Button1Down:Connect(function()
    sKnife:Play(); sSword:Play()
    lHand.Weld.C0 = lHand.Weld.C0 * CFrame.new(0,0,-2.5)
    rHand.Weld.C0 = rHand.Weld.C0 * CFrame.new(0,0,-2.5)
    task.wait(0.08)
    lHand.Weld.C0 = CFrame.new(-3, 1, 0)
    rHand.Weld.C0 = CFrame.new(3, 1, 0)
end)

-- 6. НОВАЯ ПЛАВНАЯ АНИМАЦИЯ (БЕЗ ВРАЩЕНИЯ ГОЛОВЫ)
spawn(function()
    while task.wait() do
        local t = tick()
        -- Голова плавно ходит вверх-вниз по оси Y (4 + синус)
        head.Weld.C0 = CFrame.new(0, 4 + math.sin(t*1.5)*0.4, 0) 
        
        -- Руки плавно качаются
        lHand.Weld.C0 = lHand.Weld.C0:Lerp(CFrame.new(-3, 1 + math.cos(t*3)*0.4, 0.5 * math.sin(t)), 0.1)
        rHand.Weld.C0 = rHand.Weld.C0:Lerp(CFrame.new(3, 1 + math.sin(t*3)*0.4, 0.5 * math.cos(t)), 0.1)
    end
end)

print("Глеб, V9 готова! Голова ровная и плавает вверх-вниз. ⚔️🦾🧱")

scripts.script:
--[[
    GLEB'S TIME STOP V1 ⏳💣
    - Замораживает игроков и предметы (локально)
    - Останавливает звуки
    - Бомбы застывают в воздухе до возобновления времени
--]]

local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local char = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local pGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local isStopped = false
local frozenObjects = {}
local frozenSounds = {}

-- 1. СОЗДАЕМ КНОПКУ
if pGui:FindFirstChild("TimeStopGui") then pGui.TimeStopGui:Destroy() end
local sg = Instance.new("ScreenGui", pGui)
sg.Name = "TimeStopGui"

local btn = Instance.new("TextButton", sg)
btn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 70)
btn.Position = UDim2.new(0.05, 0, 0.2, 0)
btn.Text = "STOP TIME ⏳"
btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 200)
btn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
btn.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
btn.TextSize = 25
Instance.new("UICorner", btn)

-- 2. ФУНКЦИЯ СПАВНА БОМБЫ (КОТОРАЯ ЖДЕТ ВРЕМЕНИ)
local function spawnBomb()
    local bomb = Instance.new("Part", game.Workspace)
    bomb.Size = Vector3.new(3, 3, 3)
    bomb.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
    bomb.Color = Color3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
    bomb.Position = char.HumanoidRootPart.Position + (char.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame.LookVector * 5)
    bomb.Material = Enum.Material.Metal
    
    if isStopped then
        bomb.Anchored = true -- Застывает в воздухе!
    else
        bomb.Anchored = false
    end
    
    -- Когда время пойдет, она взорвется
    bomb:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Anchored"):Connect(function()
        if not bomb.Anchored then
            task.wait(0.5) -- Небольшая задержка после пуска времени
            local ex = Instance.new("Explosion", game.Workspace)
            ex.Position = bomb.Position
            bomb:Destroy()
        end
    end)
end

-- Кнопка для спавна бомбы (дополнительная)
local bombBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", sg)
bombBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 70)
bombBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.05, 0, 0.32, 0)
bombBtn.Text = "SPAWN BOMB 💣"
bombBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 0, 0)
bombBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
bombBtn.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
bombBtn.TextSize = 25
Instance.new("UICorner", bombBtn)
bombBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(spawnBomb)

-- 3. ГЛАВНАЯ ЛОГИКА ВРЕМЕНИ
btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    isStopped = not isStopped
    
    if isStopped then
        btn.Text = "RESUME TIME ▶️"
        btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 150, 0)
        
        -- Замораживаем всё вокруг
        for _, obj in pairs(game.Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
            if obj:IsA("BasePart") and not obj:IsDescendantOf(char) then
                if not obj.Anchored then
                    obj.Anchored = true
                    table.insert(frozenObjects, obj)
                end
            elseif obj:IsA("Sound") and not obj:IsDescendantOf(char) then
                if obj.IsPlaying then
                    obj:Pause()
                    table.insert(frozenSounds, obj)
                end
            end
        end
    else
        btn.Text = "STOP TIME ⏳"
        btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 200)
        
        -- Размораживаем детали (возвращаем гравитацию)
        for _, obj in pairs(frozenObjects) do
            if obj and obj.Parent then
                obj.Anchored = false
            end
        end
        
        -- Включаем звуки
        for _, snd in pairs(frozenSounds) do
            if snd and snd.Parent then
                snd:Resume()
            end
        end
        
        -- Очищаем списки
        frozenObjects = {}
        frozenSounds = {}
    end
end)

print("Глеб, магия времени активирована! ⏳🥓")

--[[
    PROJECT: SILENT BLUE DESTRUCTOR (NO CHAT NEEDED)
    DEVELOPER: GEMINI (FOR GLEB)
    FEATURES: BILLBOARD TEXT, SKY FLASH, GLOBAL SOUND
--]]

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local lp = Players.LocalPlayer
local mouse = lp:GetMouse()

local tool = Instance.new("Tool")
tool.Name = "Gleb's Blue Laser"
tool.RequiresHandle = true

local handle = Instance.new("Part", tool)
handle.Name = "Handle"
handle.Size = Vector3.new(0.5, 1.2, 2.5)

local mesh = Instance.new("SpecialMesh", handle)
mesh.MeshId = "rbxassetid://130099641"
mesh.TextureId = "rbxassetid://130093033"
mesh.Scale = Vector3.new(1.1, 1.1, 1.1)

local function addSound(id, name, parent)
    local s = Instance.new("Sound", parent or handle)
    s.SoundId = "rbxassetid://" .. id
    s.Volume = 5 -- ОЧЕНЬ ГРОМКО
    s.RollOffMaxDistance = 500 -- Слышно издалека
    return s
end

local fireSound = addSound("130113322", "Fire")
local reloadSound = addSound("130113370", "Reload")

-- ЭФФЕКТ ДЛЯ ВСЕХ БЕЗ ЧАТА
local function showGlebPower(character)
    -- 1. ТЕКСТ НАД ГОЛОВОЙ (ВИДЯТ ВСЕ)
    local head = character:FindFirstChild("Head")
    if head then
        local gui = Instance.new("BillboardGui", head)
        gui.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 50)
        gui.AlwaysOnTop = true
        gui.ExtentsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
        
        local text = Instance.new("TextLabel", gui)
        text.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
        text.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        text.Text = "DELETED" -- Или просто синий череп
        text.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 255)
        text.TextScaled = true
        text.Font = Enum.Font.LuckiestGuy
        Debris:AddItem(gui, 2)
    end

    -- 2. ВСПЫШКА НЕБА (FE ЭФФЕКТ)
    local oldColor = Lighting.OutdoorAmbient
    Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(0, 170, 255)
    task.delay(0.2, function() Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = oldColor end)

    -- РАЗРУШЕНИЕ ВСЕГО
    for _, item in pairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
        if item:IsA("BasePart") or item:IsA("Accessory") or item:IsA("Shirt") then
            task.spawn(function()
                if item:IsA("BasePart") then
                    item.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 255)
                    item.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
                end
                task.wait(0.3)
                item:Destroy()
            end)
        end
    end
end

-- СТРЕЛЬБА
local db = false
tool.Activated:Connect(function()
    if db then return end
    db = true
    fireSound:Play()
    reloadSound:Play()

    local startPos = handle.Position
    local targetPos = mouse.Hit.p
    local direction = (targetPos - startPos).Unit

    -- ЖИРНЫЙ ЛУЧ
    local beam = Instance.new("Part", workspace)
    beam.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 170, 255)
    beam.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
    beam.Anchored = true
    beam.CanCollide = false
    beam.Size = Vector3.new(0.8, 0.8, 10)
    beam.CFrame = CFrame.new(startPos, targetPos)

    task.spawn(function()
        for i = 1, 20 do
            beam.CFrame = beam.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -15)
            task.wait(0.01)
        end
        beam:Destroy()
    end)

    -- ХИТБОКС (СФЕРА)
    local rayParam = RaycastParams.new()
    rayParam.FilterDescendantsInstances = {lp.Character, tool}
    rayParam.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    local result = workspace:Spherecast(startPos, 3, direction * 500, rayParam)

    if result and result.Instance then
        local victim = result.Instance.Parent
        if victim:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
            local hitSnd = addSound("130113415", "Hit", result.Instance)
            hitSnd:Play()
            showGlebPower(victim)
        end
    end

    task.wait(1)
    db = false
end)

tool.Parent = lp.Backpack
print("ГЛЕБ, ЛАЗЕР ГОТОВ! РАБОТАЕТ БЕЗ ЧАТА.")
